==Description==
The '''Bruh''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that could only be found in the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|legacy Hidden Wave]], meaning that it could only be found in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode.

The '''Bruh''' had slightly fast speed and had high health.

==Appearance==
The '''Bruh''' had a very unique appearance. It was the same size as the [[Fallen]]. It was completely made out of translucent blue glass, making it reflect the skybox of the map. The '''Bruh''' was also faceless. A speaker icon could also be seen above its head.

==Strategy==
*Use high DPS towers, such as the [[Accelerator]], [[Ranger]] and [[Turret]] to kill the '''Bruh'''.
**The [[Commander]] is essential in boosting the firerate of towers to help defeat the '''Bruh'''.
***Throughout the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]], you should be chaining the [[Commander]]'s ''Call to Arms'' ability.
*The [[Freezer]], [[Frost Blaster]], [[Sledger]], [[Toxic Gunner]] and [[Electroshocker]] help greatly in slowing this enemy down.
